raw_response:
I managed to get fertilizer coupons through the subsidy program this season, so I will apply both NPK and urea on my maize plot, though I cannot afford the full recommended amount for all 1.36 hectares. I will also use the hybrid seed that came with the subsidy pack because it gives better yields than our local variety, but I do not have enough manure for such a large area and I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation. My children and I will do most of the work ourselves, but during weeding and harvest I will need to hire a few extra hands.
